title: IQA lane done file
description: Structured lane-completion report a detached Paseo worker writes before pinging its parent. JSON shape is mandatory; the human-readable final message rides alongside it (dual format — see the paseo-child-agents skill, Rule 3). Field values are statuses, SHAs, paths, and numbers only — never credential values, tokens, emails, or passwords.

version.description: Schema version. Bump the const and the validator together; readers reject unknown versions.

status.description: Finished = work complete and pushed. Blocked = stopped early; blocker names the owner and what is needed.

agentShortId.description: Short id of the reporting worker (matches the watchdog/lane-watch inventory and the done-file name).

branch.description: Branch carrying the lane's commits. Must exist on origin (checked by validate-done.mjs).

shas.description: Lane commit SHAs (full or abbreviated, hex). Finished lanes list at least one; Blocked lanes may list none.

reportPath.description: Path to the lane's full report file (e.g. <worktree>/.iqa-report.md). Optional but expected on Finished.

evidencePaths.description: Paths proving the work (report file, test output, screenshots). Each must exist (checked by validate-done.mjs).

gates.description: Gate name to result (e.g. {"node-check": "pass 2/2", "tests": "142/142"}). Finished lanes record every gate the brief required.

verdict.description: Review-lane verdict where applicable (conventional values: ACCEPT, REWORK, ACCEPT_WITH_NOTES). Omitted by non-review lanes.

blocker.description: Required when status is Blocked: owner plus what is needed to unblock. Omitted when Finished.

summary.description: One-line human-readable result — the same text as the companion .txt final message.
